name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 4), (0, 5), (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 5), (2, 4), (2, 5), (3, 5)] as a QUBO with dimod and solve it with SimulatedAnnealingSampler from dwave-samplers. Verify against brute force. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
